[[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|right]]
[[Heat Infliction]] is an [[Arts Infliction]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Heat Infliction]] is a debuff applied by both Operators and Enemies lasting for {{Color|20|1d}} seconds. If Heat Infliction is applied to a unit who already has Heat Infliction, then the debuff's duration is reset and the Heat Infliction gains a stack (up to a maximum of 4 stacks).

===Friendly===

Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Heat Infliction]].
* If an Operator applies a Heat Infliction to an enemy with Heat Infliction, then a [[Arts Burst|Heat Burst]] is triggered dealing {{Color|160% ATK|1d}} as {{Color|Heat DMG|3}}.
* If an Operator applies a Heat Infliction to an enemy with a [[Arts Infliction|Non-Heat Infliction]], then [[Combustion]] is triggered.

===Hostile===

Some [[Enemies]] are capable of applying [[Heat Infliction]].
* If the Operator recieves 4 stacks of [[Heat Infliction]], then [[Combustion]] is triggered.

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Heat Infliction}} can now stack up to four times.
*** [[Arts Burst|Heat Burst]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Heat Infliction to an enemy with Heat Infliction, add one more stack of Heat Infliction (up to 4 times) and trigger a Heat Burst.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies Heat Infliction to an enemy with Heat Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Heat Inflictions and trigger an Heat Burst.
*** [[Combustion]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Heat Infliction to an enemy with a non-Heat Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} existing stacks of Heat Infliction to trigger [[Combustion]] with the latter determining the strength or {{G|Status Level}} of the reaction.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies a Heat Infliction to an enemy with a non-Heat Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger Combustion.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Heat Infliction}} added.
*** When an Operator applies Heat Infliction to an enemy with Heat Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Heat Inflictions and trigger an [[Arts Burst|Heat Burst]].
*** When an Operator applies Heat Infliction to an enemy with a non-Heat Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger [[Combustion]].
}}
